editorial.blurb: A beloved traditional Cantonese spot serving generous portions of well-executed seafood and classic Chinese dishes in a relaxed, old-school banquet hall setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Come during lunch for the lunch specials—reviewers rave about the value and portion sizes. For groups, order the family dinner for 6 and go for the seafood basket, salt and pepper shrimp, and fried fish.
